rule: The string literals of runner/*.py that are behaviour and hold a stack word or a detection text: exact entries, one reason each. A stack word in any other string literal of a runner file is a finding, and an entry that no literal equals any more is a finding too (test/runner-text.test.mjs). Public, no trap content.

entries.reason: the first runtime's own out-of-memory line, matched whole against a stderr line (rs_abort.py DOTNET_LINE)
the exception name the first runtime prints for an out-of-memory abort, searched in the stderr tail (rs_abort.py DOTNET_EXCEPTION)
the second runtime's own out-of-memory message, searched in a stderr line (rs_abort.py V8_TEXT)
the label of the first runtime that runtimeAbort returns and the record carries (rs_abort.py _kind)
the label of the second runtime that runtimeAbort returns and the record carries (rs_abort.py _kind)
